क्या 5,000 सैनिक पूरी सेना को रोक पाए? ⚔️
topics.hook: Do you know how a massive army was halted in a narrow ravine?
beats: Do you know how a massive army was halted in a narrow ravine?
In September 1660, this fierce clash occurred at Pavan Khind near Vishalgad.
Bijapur commanders Siddi Masud and Fazl Khan were pursuing Shivaji from Panhala.
Baji Prabhu Deshpande was ordered to hold the narrow ravine with 5,000 men.
Bijapur forces launched three assaults, but the brave rearguard repelled every wave.
Cannons signaled Shivaji's safety, while Baji Prabhu died alongside 700 Marathas.
The Bijapur army failed to capture Shivaji and retreated back to their territory.

topics.title: CHOLA EMPIRE ने गंगा को कैसे जीता? 🚩
topics.hook: Can a South Indian king conquer the Ganges after marching 2500 kilometers on foot?
beats: Can a South Indian king conquer the Ganges after marching 2500 kilometers on foot?
In 1019 AD, the great Chola Emperor Rajendra I marched towards Northern India with his army.
In his path stood the heavy armies of King Indraratha and powerful Bengal rulers.
General Araiyan launched a deadly military campaign using Sakkarakkottam in Madhya Pradesh as his base.
The Chola army defeated Dharmapala of Dandabhukti and then the Pala King Mahipala in battle.
Finally, carrying holy Ganges water, the Chola army returned south and hoisted their victory flag.
In memory of this historic victory, he built a massive and holy reservoir named Cholaganga.

A golden pot decorated with flowers and overflowing with clear river water

topics.title: 78 लोग और ब्रिटिश साम्राज्य की हार? 😱
topics.hook: Can just 78 people alone shake the power of the vast British Raj?
beats: Can just 78 people alone shake the power of the vast British Raj?
On March 12, 1930, this historic and brave foot march began from Sabarmati Ashram.
The cruel 1882 British Salt Act had snatched the basic rights from poor Indians.
Gandhi ji made the tough decision to walk about 387 kilometers to Dandi.
In this 24-day march, thousands of Indians joined and the whole world watched.
By making salt at Dandi on April 6 morning, he completely broke British law.
60,000 people were jailed, but this non-violent revolution showed the way to sovereignty.

topics.title: 26 साल के सेनापति ने कैसे हिला दिया पूरा साम्राज्य? 😱
topics.hook: How could an empire be invaded without any naval power?
beats: How could an empire be invaded without any naval power?
In 218 BC, Hannibal marched from Cartagena with his Carthaginian army.
Roman-backed Saguntum stood ahead, while Rome held total dominance over the seas.
To evade Rome's navy, he crossed the Ebro River via an unexpected path.
Bypassing Roman garrisons, he crossed the Alps directly into Italy.
At just 26 years old, he pulled off history's most shocking military march.
To achieve the impossible, one must dare to take the hardest route.
